ex.en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
ex.zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.zh: 控制；管理；抑制；操纵装置

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒

ex.en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
ex.zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。

ex.en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。

col: a spirit of cooperation｜合作精神
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

ex.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
ex.zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。

ex.en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
ex.zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。
📘 8B Unit 1

senses.zh: 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 📘 8B Unit 1。作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。
📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 1
📘 8B Unit 2

senses.zh: 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事

ex.en: We cheered as our neighbour crossed the finish line.
ex.zh: 邻居冲过终点线时，我们欢呼起来。

ex.en: When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。

col: a loud cheer｜响亮的欢呼声
cheer for a team｜为球队喝彩
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。cheer on指加油助威；cheer up指振作或使高兴。

senses.zh: 振作起来；高兴起来；使高兴起来

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2
📘 8B Unit 2

ex.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。

ex.en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
ex.zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

col: volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙
volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

senses.zh: 想出(一个主意或计划)；提出；提供；筹措

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2
📘 8B Unit 2

senses.zh: 迹象；符号；记号；手势；指示牌

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。

ex.en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
ex.zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

col: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
ex.zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？

ex.en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
ex.zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。

col: at short notice｜在通知很仓促的情况下
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。
📘 8B Unit 2
📘 8B Unit 2

senses.zh: （用于过去持续或经常发生的事）曾经
习惯于；过去经常；的用法

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2

ex.en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
ex.zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。

ex.en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。
📘 8B Unit 2

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.zh: 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

senses.zh: 感觉，触觉；感情，情绪；同情
感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸
有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的

ex.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
ex.zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。

ex.en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
ex.zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。

col: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉
hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

senses.zh: 满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪

ex.en: He smiled with satisfaction after fixing the broken chair.
ex.zh: 修好那把坏椅子后，他满意地笑了。

ex.en: Greater job satisfaction can reduce staff turnover and encourage employees to contribute more actively to their organisations.
ex.zh: 更高的工作满意度可以减少人员流失，并鼓励员工更积极地为所在机构作贡献。

col: the satisfaction of basic needs｜基本需求的满足
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。

ex.en: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
ex.zh: 开始下雪时，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。

ex.en: Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 社区花园既能给居民带来欢乐，也能加强社会联系并鼓励更健康的生活方式。

col: jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
the joys of parenthood｜为人父母的乐趣
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

ex.en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
ex.zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

senses.zh: (采用前)严密试验；筛矿；量(金属的)纯度

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2

ex.en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。

ex.en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。

col: a journey of discovery｜探索之旅
make a journey｜进行一次旅行
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

ex.en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
ex.zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。

ex.en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
ex.zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。

ex.en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
ex.zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

col: fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

senses.zh: 修理；解决；组织；安顿住处

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2
📘 8B Unit 2
📘 8B Unit 2

senses.zh: 折断；打碎；损坏（break的过去分词）

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.zh: 转动；使变换方向；给…装轮子
旋转；突然转变方向；盘旋飞行

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

senses.zh: 信；字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义

ex.en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

ex.en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
ex.zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

senses.en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something
to feel sad because someone or something is absent
to fail to hit a target or notice something

ex.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
ex.zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。

ex.en: Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 缺了几节课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的进度。

col: miss the bus｜没赶上公交车
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。miss后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
📘 8B Unit 2

senses.zh: 使…失去能力（disable的过去分词）

ex.en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
ex.zh: 游泳池设有供残障游泳者使用的升降设备。

ex.en: Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.
ex.zh: 大学应提供无障碍设施和适当支持，确保残障学生能够充分参与校园生活。

col: disabled parking space｜残障人士专用停车位
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

senses.zh: 发生差别；使…有差别；(结果等)是重要的

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2

ex.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
ex.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。

ex.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。

col: blind to the risks｜无视风险
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

ex.en: My deaf cousin taught me some useful everyday signs.
ex.zh: 我失聪的表亲教了我一些实用的日常手语。

ex.en: Providing captions and sign language interpretation can make public information more accessible to deaf people.
ex.zh: 提供字幕和手语翻译可以让聋人更方便地获取公共信息。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。读音同def；大写Deaf可强调聋人文化身份。

ex.en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
ex.zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。

ex.en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

ex.en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
ex.zh: 我手湿着，很难打开那个罐子。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.zh: 公开的；敞开的；空旷的；坦率的；营业着的

ex.en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
ex.zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
ex.zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。

col: open to the public｜向公众开放
open to suggestions｜愿意听取建议
keep an open mind｜保持开放心态
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

ex.en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
ex.zh: 请关上门，别让猫跑出去。

ex.en: Installing wider doors in public buildings can make everyday journeys easier for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑中安装更宽的门，可以让轮椅使用者的日常出行更方便。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。at the door指在门口；answer the door指应声开门。

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？

ex.en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
ex.zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。

ex.en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
ex.zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

ex.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
ex.zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。

ex.en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
ex.zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。

ex.en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
ex.zh: 她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。

ex.en: Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有机会帮助遇到个人困难的同学，从而培养他们的善意。

col: kindness towards others｜对他人的善意
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
ex.zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。

ex.en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。过去式和过去分词均为understood。

ex.en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，我们改变了计划。

ex.en: Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.
ex.zh: 政府应调整交通政策，鼓励骑行并减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。

senses.zh: 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行
使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与

ex.en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。

ex.en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。

col: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

senses.zh: 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

ex.en: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
ex.zh: 女士，您想坐靠窗的桌子吗？

ex.en: In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.
ex.zh: 在正式的客户服务场合，工作人员可能用madam称呼女性顾客，以示尊重。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 2。正式称呼女性时使用；日常熟人交谈中通常不用。

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

ex.en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
ex.zh: 请把这些毛巾叠好，放到架子上。

ex.en: Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.
ex.zh: 当租金上涨导致无法维持合理利润时，小企业可能倒闭。

col: fold your arms｜双臂交叉抱在胸前
fold up a chair｜把椅子折起来
fold the laundry｜叠洗好的衣物
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。fold强调折叠；bend只表示弯曲，不一定叠合。

ex.en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。

ex.en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。过去式、过去分词均为 swept。

senses.zh: 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席
铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒

ex.en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。

ex.en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
ex.zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

senses.zh: 混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西
把事情弄糟；制造脏乱；玩弄

ex.en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
ex.zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
ex.zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。
📘 8B Unit 3

ex.en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
ex.zh: 两件夹克都不合身，所以我会继续挑选。

ex.en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
ex.zh: 两种方法都无法单独解决交通拥堵，因此城市需要将投资与监管相结合。

col: neither of them｜他们两个都不
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。neither只用于两者；接单数名词，常与nor搭配。

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.zh: 一……就；一怎么样就怎么样；一经

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3

senses.zh: 及格；经过；护照；途径；传球

ex.en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。

ex.en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

senses.zh: 借；借用；从其他语言中引入

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？

ex.en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
ex.zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

ex.en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？

ex.en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。

col: lend someone something｜把某物借给某人
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

ex.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
ex.zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。

ex.en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

senses.zh: 家庭杂务；日常的零星事务；讨厌的或累人的工作

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3
📘 8B Unit 3

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.zh: 压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读
强调；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读

ex.en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
ex.zh: 散一小会儿步有助于我缓解工作压力。

ex.en: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
ex.zh: 学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。

col: stress the importance of｜强调…的重要性
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

senses.zh: 浪费；废物；荒地；损耗；地面风化物

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
ex.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。
📘 8B Unit 3

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
ex.zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

col: provide access to｜提供使用……的机会
provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

senses.zh: 无论如何，不管怎样；总之

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
ex.zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。

ex.en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。

col: do it anyway｜无论如何还是去做
thanks anyway｜不管怎样还是谢谢你
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

senses.zh: 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖

ex.en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
ex.zh: 我们周末的安排取决于天气怎么样。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。
📘 8B Unit 3

senses.zh: 开发；进步；使成长；使显影

ex.en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
ex.zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

ex.en: Learning to cook gave him a sense of independence.
ex.zh: 学会做饭让他有了自立的感觉。

ex.en: Accessible housing can help older people maintain their independence while remaining connected to their local communities.
ex.zh: 无障碍住房可以帮助老年人保持独立生活，同时维系与当地社区的联系。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。
📘 8B Unit 3

senses.zh: 因为；由于；既然；自…以来；自…以后

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
ex.zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。

ex.en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
ex.zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。
📘 8B Unit 3

senses.zh: n. 邻居;同胞；仁慈的人
住在邻近；毗邻；友善，和睦

ex.en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
ex.zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。

ex.en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
ex.zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。
📘 8B Unit 3

senses.zh: 生病的；坏的；邪恶的；不吉利的

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

senses.zh: 滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出

ex.en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
ex.zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。

ex.en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。

col: a drop in prices｜价格下降
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

senses.zh: 独立的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的

ex.en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
ex.zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.zh: 公平的；美丽的，白皙的； 晴朗的

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

ex.en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。

ex.en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。

col: unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。
